title: Quiet hide-away, minutes from downtown & airport!
description:
This beautiful private suite is located in a quiet neighborhood, 7 minutes from the airport and 15 - 20 minutes from downtown and really just about anywhere . You an enjoy a run or walk through the friendly neighborhood before you start your day. We're close to 65, 24, 40, Briley and 440, there are many options to access exploration into the Nashville scene. If you want to just hang out, you can savor shared outdoor spaces, free wi-fi, and a smart TV.

The space
This suite is quiet, private and comfortable. The bedroom features a queen-sized bed, with an orthopedic mattress. There's a separate coffee/ breakfast area where can work or just grab a bite.  The private bathroom is the best, great shower, heated towel bar and beautiful accommodations.

Guest access
Guests enter through a private entrance with a keypad, right next to their parking.

During your stay
Feel free to message me I'll reach back as soon as I can.

Other things to note
The neighborhood is very safe feel free to take a walk or go for a run. A grocery store less than 2 miles away. You'll also find I handful of great restaurants in the same shopping center.
